Clean HD hand-painted 2D side-view game art reference for a whimsical physics puzzle game called OVER THE RAINBOW. Wide 16:9 side-view landscape, no UI, no text, scenery-only background: luminous blue sky, layered distant mountains, rolling green hills, soft atmospheric depth, fluffy detailed clouds, gentle meadow colors, painterly but crisp game readability, charming storybook style, no player, no vehicles, no platforms, no foreground collision objects, no labels.
